data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Phase C is EPIC-scoped (ticket next-batch <epic-id>); story_id is NOT in scope before next-batch. The helper must accept the epic id and internally enumerate descendant stories (or be invoked per-story in an orchestrator loop) — specify which. Helper idempotency (skip existing edge) is sufficient for repeated per-batch invocation; NO once-per-story guard is required.
